evidence.title: Students and police clash as France struggles to quell school protests
evidence.finding: Updated report explicitly describes Friday clashes, classroom conditions/funding demands, tear gas, closures, and fires. Byline includes Layli Foroudi and Katya Skvortsova. Older search-index version has a different headline and shorter Charlotte Van Campenhout byline; this is a version difference, not proof of a fabricated date.

events.status_advice: Keep unknown. An observation on Oct 2 and planned later strike establish neither present-moment activity nor end. Do not infer exact onset from last week or last month.
events.outcome_advice: Do not infer a student victory from a below-inflation proposed education budget increase, or an end from school closures. A proposal is not enacted relief.

evidence.title: Spain’s parliament rejects gov’t housing decrees amid mass protests
evidence.finding: Page dates itself Oct 2 and describes Friday legislative rejection and a Madrid renters' protest. It also describes a continuing encampment and a preliminary agreement for an evicted resident to return.

events.status_advice: Keep unknown. No end or suspension is reported; rejection of measures is not cessation.
events.outcome_advice: A documented October 2 legislative defeat is a limited setback for the government and supporters of these decrees. Describe whose preferred policy failed; do not claim all renters lost, landlords won, or the protest caused the rejection. One resident's preliminary return agreement is neither a completed return nor a nationwide housing victory.
